title: Shocking Transformation of the Secret Realm
next_chapter_hook: In the instant when the low hum from the depths of the seal resonated with the Tianji Record, Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his brow center—a warning of the Heavenly Fate Value draining frantically. He knew that something that should not have been awakened was slowly opening its eyes.

text.content: In the core area of the secret realm, the spiritual energy between heaven and earth was so dense it almost solidified into tangible form. Chen Ji's reconnaissance team had ventured deep for three days, encountering over a hundred restrictive mechanisms along the way, each of which he circumvented with uncanny intuition. The disciples of the Tianqing Sect following behind held blind admiration for this 'trash senior brother'—unaware that this supposedly worthless senior disciple was rapidly calculating every move in his mental chess game.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's voice resonated within Chen Ji's mental sea, carrying an undertone of gravity. 'The spiritual energy concentration here is abnormal,' she said, 'at least thirty percent denser than what's recorded in the Holy Sect's ancient secret realm texts. Someone is replenishing the spiritual energy behind us.'

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze flickered as his eyes narrowed slightly. The Tianji Record Fragment in his mental sea radiated a faint warmth—this was the signal of its foresight ability being triggered, but it didn't feel like a simple warning. It was more like... a summons. He said nothing, merely slowing his pace marginally, allowing the team to maintain a three-zhang distance behind him.

dialogue.content: 'Ye Qing, have you heard the term 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' in the Holy Sect?' Chen Ji's voice was extremely low, barely perceptible to anyone but Ye Qing through their spiritual connection. This was the first time he had proactively inquired about clues regarding Chen Nian.

text.content: Ye Qing fell silent for a moment before speaking: 'The Holy Sect does have relevant records, but they're all top-secret... How do you know—' Before she could finish, a blinding golden light suddenly blazed at the tunnel's end ahead. The seal! Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—the pressure contained within that golden light far exceeded ordinary restrictions, carrying the primordial, vast的气息 of ancient times.

'Disperse!' Chen Ji roared, his spiritual energy instantly forming a barrier before him. Just as everyone frantically retreated, he noticed a critical detail—the golden light hadn't been triggered but was being... deliberately guided toward their position. Someone was manipulating all of this from behind the scenes.

choice.prompt: The seal is showing strange fluctuations, golden light gathering toward them, with someone clearly manipulating from the shadows. The team has been exposed to danger—how will you respond to this sudden crisis?

choices.description: Immediately retreat, use the Tianji Record to foresee changes within the next three hours, find a safe route and replan
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete intelligence, grasp the enemy's布局
choices.risk_hint: May miss the opportunity to seize the initiative

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flashed. The Tianji Record Fragment rotated abruptly. Within five breaths, he saw it—the seal was not a single restriction but composed of three nested formations, with the outermost layer already modified by someone. Their current position happened to be the trigger point of the third formation layer. 'Retreat three zhang to the left. There's a blind spot in the formation there.' His voice was terrifyingly calm.

choices.description: Turn the tables, forcibly charge along the direction the golden light is guiding, directly strike the seal's core
choices.visible_reward: Seize the core area first, gain the initiative
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk of direct confrontation

text.content: A cold smirk curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth. 'Since someone wants to invite us into the trap, let's comply with their wishes.' Before the words even finished, his figure exploded forward, shooting directly toward where the golden light was gathering, his speed so swift that even Ye Qing couldn't stop him. The disciples behind cried out in alarm, yet Chen Ji formed a single hand seal, actually forcing that golden light to be drawn toward his palm.

dialogue.content: 'You're mad! That's an ancient seal, not—' Ye Qing's voice cut off abruptly, because she sensed the nature of the force in Chen Ji's palm. It wasn't pure spiritual energy, but... demonic path techniques! And extremely pure demonic path techniques, identical to what she cultivated.

text.content: Chen Ji gave no answer, merely forcibly compressing that golden light into a sphere and hurling it toward the disciples behind. 'Catch.' He spoke without turning his head. The disciples behind let out startled cries, yet that sphere of golden light suddenly dispersed mid-air, transforming into countless fine threads that entered each person's brow center—it was some kind of protective restriction. Chen Ji had completed the formation modification in the blink of an eye.

At this moment, a low, resonant hum echoed from the depths of the seal. That wasn't the sound of mechanism operation, but the breathing of some creature—extremely ancient, extremely massive, each exhalation causing the space to tremble slightly. Ye Qing's face instantly went deathly pale: 'This is... impossible! How could there be—' inside the seal?

choice.prompt: An ancient existence within the seal is awakening, while simultaneously you sense a familiar aura—the unique aura of the demonic path. This is definitely not coincidence—who is orchestrating everything from behind the scenes?

choices.description: First assess the situation, have Ye Qing confirm the source of the demonic path aura
choices.visible_reward: Confirm the identity of the mastermind
choices.risk_hint: May miss the timing for retreat

dialogue.content: Ye Qing closed her eyes, her spiritual sense extending outward with all her might. After three breaths, she suddenly opened them, her eyes filled with disbelief: 'This aura... is at the level of Holy Sect Elder! And not just one person—at least three! They used demonic path miasma to conceal their auras. If I wasn't extremely familiar with this cultivation technique, I would never have detected them.'

choices.description: Without废话, directly attack the source of the demonic path aura
choices.visible_reward: Strike first, disrupt the enemy's rhythm

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated not a moment, spiritual energy suddenly condensing in his palm, forming an invisible sword Qi that slashed toward the left rock wall. 'Come out.' His voice was cold as frost. The next second, the rock wall shattered, and three black shadows stumbled out狼狈ly, the leader's face ashen—he had never expected his demonic path miasma to be seen through by a mere servant disciple of the Tianqing Sect.

At the same time, the low hum from the seal grew increasingly distinct. That voice seemed to come from the abyss of the Nine Netherworlds, carrying a soul-shaking pressure that made one's spirit tremble. Chen Ji felt a burning sensation in his chest—the Tianji Record Fragment was vibrating frantically, and blurry images emerged in his mental sea: a pair of eyes covering the sky, slowly opening from the depths of the seal.

dialogue.content: 'Ye Qing,' Chen Ji's voice was pressed extremely low, 'did the Holy Sect open this secret realm?' His gaze wasn't on Ye Qing but死死盯着 the direction from which the golden light was flowing. He was testing—if Ye Qing knew about this, her reaction would betray her.

Ye Qing shook her head, her expression uncharacteristically serious: 'The Holy Sect was indeed searching for this secret realm, but it had never been opened before I arrived. This异变... was deliberately triggered by someone.' She paused, lowering her voice, 'And those three auras—they're not here for us—they're here to awaken what lies within the seal.'

text.content: A cold smile formed in Chen Ji's heart. Awaken the sealed entity? What bold ambition. Three Holy Sect Elder-level figures, risking exposure of their identities to infiltrate the Tianqing Sect's secret realm, just to awaken an ancient existence? The interests involved here were far greater than he had imagined. Ye Qing's proactive offer of cooperation showed she too had been driven into a corner.

choice.prompt: The situation has become clear—someone is awakening an ancient existence within the seal, and you must make a choice: stop all this, or... take advantage of the chaos to secure greater benefits?

choices.description: Join forces with Ye Qing to suppress the seal's fluctuations, protect the secret realm from destruction
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large amount of spiritual energy
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ye Qing's complete trust, uncover part of the Holy Sect's conspiracy
choices.risk_hint: May face direct conflict with the three elders

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, his hands forming complex seals. 'I need your cooperation.' he said to Ye Qing, 'Your demonic path miasma can conceal my aura. I need ten breaths of time to re-stabilize the sealing formation.' Ye Qing gave him a deep look, then nodded. The next instant, mist as black as ink poured from her body, completely shrouding Chen Ji.

choices.memory_label: 夜清第一次完全信任陈机的判断

choices.description: Let them awaken that thing, while you seize control of the seal's core in the chaos
choices.visible_reward: Gain control of the seal's core, strength greatly increased
choices.risk_hint: May be targeted by the ancient existence

dialogue.content: A meaningfully profound smile curved the corner of Chen Ji's lips. 'Let them fight it out.' His voice carried a hint of icy coldness, 'Since that thing wants to emerge, someone has to pay the price. The lives of those three elders will serve nicely as a sacrifice.' Ye Qing's pupils contracted sharply, and a complex wariness flickered in her gaze as she looked at Chen Ji. This man was more... ruthless than she had imagined.

choices.memory_label: 夜清首次见识到陈机的真实面目

text.content: Just at this moment, a沉闷的低鸣 echoed from the depths of the seal. That sound was no longer a faint breathing but a clear... call. Chen Ji felt a intense pain in his brow center, the Tianji Record Fragment seemingly being drawn by some force, vibrating frantically. He knew that something was watching here, watching him. And the malice contained within that gaze made his very soul tremble.
